info.title: OpenStreetlifting API
info.description:
Read streetlifting competitions, athletes, rankings, records and RIS scores from the OpenStreetlifting archive.

**Conventions**

- Weights are in kilograms. Most weights and scores are decimal strings, such as `"315.5"`. Ranking values are JSON numbers.
- Dates use `YYYY-MM-DD`. Country codes use ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
- `MPDS` is the event with muscle-up, pull-up, dips and squat. Shorter events use the letters of their movements, such as `PD`.
- List endpoints take `page` and `page_size`, and return `data` with `pagination`.
- `include` takes comma-separated values. Sections you do not request are left out of the response.

**Errors**

Requests the API rejects return `{"error": "..."}`. A query value of the wrong type, such as a non-numeric `year`, returns a plain-text `400`.

**Reusing the data**

See the [licensing guide](https://docs.openstreetlifting.org/LICENSING.html).

get.description:
Returns the best results in the archive, grouped by movement, sex and weight class.

Totals count only from MPDS competitions. Each athlete appears once per group, and the earlier
result ranks first on a tie.

parameters.name: movement
parameters.description: Only this lift, or `total`.

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: Only this sex.

parameters.name: weight_class
parameters.description:
A weight class such as `M-73` or `F+70`, or `open` for the best across all classes.
With a federation or series, any class it entered athletes in, such as `M-75`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as `FR`.

parameters.name: federation
parameters.description: A federation name, as listed by `/api/v1/records/facets`.

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: A competition series, as listed by `/api/v1/records/facets`.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Only lifts from competitions held in this year.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Entries per group, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 3.

AthleteInclude.description:
Optional athlete section.

`competitions` adds `competitions` and `total_competitions`, `records` adds `personal_records`,
`best_total` and `best_ris`, `standing` adds `standing`, `lift_balance` adds `lift_balance`, and
`neighbors` adds `neighbors`.

v.description: Bodyweight offset of the curve, in kilograms.
